ash: prepping a micro-night rollout for `llmroute_v3_micro`. window 23:50-01:10 UTC. plan: micro-canary 0.2% eu-west -> wait 12m -> 2% -> wait 25m -> 10% -> hold -> then assess for slow soak to 50%. pin model to model-route v3.0.4 for the duration. quiet-window 23:30-01:30. @deploybot schedule, @sre-oncall FYI.

deploybot: ack  scheduled. steps enqueued: 23:50 0.2% canary, 00:02 check, 00:10 2%, 00:35 check, 00:40 10%, 01:05 hold/assess. will post snapshots and step confirmations.

casey: rollback gates proposal: sustained p95 > 420ms (5m) OR error-rate > 0.5% (5m) OR token-queue-length > 2.2x baseline. semantic gate: quick-eval drift > 2% on curated prompts => rollback.

product-lina: add customer note: "eu-west routing experiment tonight; automatic fallback in place." RN ref RN-2026-777. keep short.

sre-oncall: standing by. will mute noisy alerts and watch p95, error-rate, cpu, token-queue-length, and quick-eval. auto-rollback configured to pin to v2.8.3. manual pin runbook link: https://go/runbooks/llmroute-micro (section "fast-pin").

deploybot: rollback action configured: set `llmroute_v3_micro=off` and pin model-route v2.8.3. ops rollback command:
```
/deploybot rollback llmroute_v3_micro --pin-version v2.8.3 --reason "auto-rollback: telemetry"
```

ash: one more: on rollback also clear per-canary prefix cache and revoke warmup tokens to avoid sticky stale routing. documented in runbook.

deploybot: canary 0.2% executed at 23:50 UTC. metrics snapshot due ~23:58.

sre-oncall: early snapshot (23:58): p95=295ms, error-rate=0.09%, cpu=44%, token-queue-length=1.1x. prelim green. holding until 00:02 check.

ash: thanks team 44d will monitor and proceed to 2% if hold OK.
